patch.value: GH-860: pm-beads --preserve-source-ids changes source ID casing

The pm-beads preserve-source-ids path changes the casing of imported Beads IDs, breaking exact identity preservation and downstream references. Preserve the authoritative source spelling byte-for-byte while retaining collision and filesystem safety.

Mixed-case and lowercase Beads IDs round-trip without spelling changes; all dependency, parent, comment, and history references resolve to the preserved IDs; collision detection remains fail-closed across case-sensitive and case-insensitive filesystems; Windows, Linux, package, and installed-consumer tests pass
Preserve canonical external identity across migrations
Keeps cross-system references, relationships, and audit trails stable
GitHub issue #860 reports an active identity-corruption defect in migration
